message: After reading through the horrors that people have had to go through I feel that my situation is fourtunatly (for me) much better. My brother who is mentally unstable has been sentenced to weekend incarceration in MD. Tonight was his first night. As I said he has some mental and emotional problems and one of the main things tha helps him get through is knowing that I am here for him and he can talk to me. In fact the last thing he said to me when I droped him off was that he would call me just as soon as he could so we could say good night or else he wouldn't be able to speak. Well he called and we had barely said hello to eachother before I was kicked over to this voice message saying I neede a T- Netixs account. I sat on hold for over thirty min. all the while just imagining how confused and scared he must be. Then I was disconeccted without speaking to anyone. That's when I went on line and found this site. I am so thankfull that he will be home on Sunday and I feel so deeply for all of you who aren't that lucky. Even though I will be able to explain everything to him and we will have to deal with the fact that we won't be able to speak while he is away on weekends, I still feel outraged. Not on my own behalf, but for everyone else. As Mike has put it, this is unconstitutional and morally wrong. I have taken the suggestions to heart and fully intend on writing letters to congrestional and state officals. Even though my situation is no where near as bad as others', anyone can see that this is disgusting and T- Netix is a morally bankrupt company. Tank you for your site. Without it, I would have had no idea what was going on. To the rest of you, my heart goes out to you and if there is anything I can do to aide in putting a stop to this I will.
